tools.name: rag_search
tools.description: Search the project knowledge base for relevant lessons and past corrections. Call before writing code, tests, commits, or any action that might have project-specific rules.

query.description: Natural language description of what you're looking for. Examples: 'how to style components', 'testing best practices', 'git commit format'

top_k.description: Number of results to return (1-10, default 5)

category.description: Optional category filter: testing, code_edit, git, architecture, pr_review, security, debugging

tools.name: apply_feedback_protocol
tools.description: Default SmartAssist feedback workflow. Call when the user corrects your approach, confirms a reusable pattern, rejects generated code, or reveals a project convention. This tool checks for duplicates, boosts existing lessons when the rule already exists, suggests merges for overlapping lessons, and only creates a new lesson when needed.

feedback.description: The user's correction, praise, or rule statement

sentiment.description: Optional sentiment hint. Omit it when the tool can infer the direction from the feedback text.

category.description: Optional category hint: testing, code_edit, git, architecture, pr_review, security, debugging

intensity.description: Optional importance level 1-5. Leave unset to let SmartAssist infer it.

context.description: Optional extra context about what you were doing when the feedback happened

tools.name: create_lesson
tools.description: Low-level lesson creation tool. Prefer apply_feedback_protocol for live feedback because it handles duplicate checks and overlap first.

lesson.description: Imperative statement (>30 chars) with an action verb. Example: 'Always use semantic colors from theme instead of hardcoded hex values'

category.description: One of: testing, code_edit, git, architecture, pr_review, security, debugging

sentiment.description: Whether this lesson came from praise or correction

context.description: What you were doing when the lesson was learned

tools.name: compare_lesson
tools.description: Draft a lesson for A/B comparison without storing it. Use when SmartAssist wants a comparison draft for feedback quality review.

lesson.description: Imperative statement (>30 chars) with an action verb

category.description: One of: testing, code_edit, git, architecture, pr_review, security, debugging

sentiment.description: Whether this draft came from praise or correction

context.description: What you were doing when the draft was generated

tools.name: rag_feedback
tools.description: Record whether the last suggestion was helpful. Updates Thompson Sampling reliability scores.

helpful.description: True if the suggestion helped, false if not

tools.name: rag_dashboard
tools.description: View current reliability scores, corpus stats, and feedback metrics.

tools.name: boost_lesson
tools.description: Increase a lesson's priority after confirmed positive impact.

lesson_id.description: The lesson ID to boost (e.g. L042)

tools.name: demote_lesson
tools.description: Decrease a lesson's priority after confirmed negative impact.

tools.name: merge_lessons
tools.description: Consolidate overlapping lessons into one stronger principle.

lesson_ids.description: Comma-separated lesson IDs to merge (for example: L001,L002,L003)
